_about: Source for scripts/audio/generate.mjs (docs/plan/NANI.md C5 to C7). Ids are fixed by docs/plan/CONTRACTS.md. Nani's voice and premade model come from content/demo.config.json. {childName} is filled from the config.

voice.text: Ooh!
Achha!
Hmm!
Haan ji!
Oho!
Achha-achha!
Tab tak teen baar taali bajao! Ek, do, teen!
Ungliyon pe gino: one, two, three, four, five!
Jaldi se bolo: one, two, three!
Ek baar lion jaisa roar karo!
Billi kaise bolti hai? Meow! Tum bhi bolo!
Gaay kaise bolti hai? Moo! Ek baar aur!
Haathi jaisi soond hilao!
Bolo mere saath: A for Apple!
M ki awaaz karo: mmmmm!
Apni naak chhuo. Nose! Nose!
Apne kaan pakdo. Ears! Ears!
Kamre mein kuch laal dhoondho. Red!
Hawa mein ek gol circle banao!
Bolo: Thank you, Nani!
Ek badi si smile do! Smile!
Ek lambi saans lo… aur chhodo. Shabaash!
Khud ko ek big hug do!
Jo abhi seekha, woh ek baar phir bolo!
M se Monkey! Bandar jaisa uchhlo!
M se Moon! Chanda mama ko hello bolo!
Mmm… M se Mango!
M se Mummy! Mummy ko ek flying kiss do!
N se Nose! Naak chhuo!
O for Orange! Bolo: orange!
Aam ka rang kya hai? Yellow!
Kela lamba aur yellow! Banana!
Seb ka rang kya hai? Red!
Santra gol hota hai! Circle banao!
Aam gino! Ek, do, teen aam!
Seepiyan gino: one, two, three!
Ek aam, ek aam, kitne? Two!
Bandar jaisa ooh, ooh, aah karo!
Nani apna chashma dhoondh rahi hai… mil gaya!
Nani ko theek se sunai nahi diya. Paw dabakar phir se bolo?
Arre, Nani ki awaaz atak gayi! Ek baar phir poochho?
Arre, Nani ka dhyaan bhatak gaya! Ek baar phir bolo, beta?
Nani thoda aaram kar rahi hai. Thodi der mein baat karte hain!
Mumma ka call aa raha hai!
Papa ka call!
Good night, {childName}! Kal phir khelenge.

music._about: R3: plays only when Nani is late (no first sentence 2.5 s after the send tap). One seamless cycle, no trims or fades. lufs: about 12 dB under Nani's live voice (eleven_v4_turbo measured at -19.4 LUFS).
music.prompt: Soft, warm, slow instrumental music loop for a five-year-old: a gentle marimba melody with light, soft tabla, cosy and calm like a lullaby, steady slow tempo, instrumental only

song.title: Ek Do Teen, Count With Me
song.style: A happy, bouncy children's counting song with a warm Indian flavour: tabla, dholak, sitar plucks and hand claps, bright and simple, about 110 BPM. Sung clearly by one warm, kind female voice, like a loving grandmother singing to a five-year-old. Every word is sung clearly.
verse: One little lion goes roar, roar, roar! (Ek sher!)
Two little cows go moo, moo, moo! (Do gaay!)
Three little cats go meow, meow, meow! (Teen billi!)
Four little ducks go quack, quack, quack! (Chaar batakh!)
Five little monkeys go ooh-ooh-aah! (Paanch bandar!)
chorus: Count with Nani, clap with me,
Learning is so much fun, you see!
song.snippetText: Ek, do, teen, chaar, paanch, One, two, three, four, five!
